name: Cowards
overview: Scripture contrasts the cowardly with the righteous by highlighting that the wicked flee without cause, while the righteous exhibit boldness like a lion. The fearful and unbelieving are listed among those who face eternal judgment, emphasizing the spiritual danger of cowardice rooted in unbelief. This theme underscores the call for believers to trust God boldly, avoiding the condemnation reserved for those who live in fear and rejection of truth.
